themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (Uber/Lyft) spiked to 44 complaints last week—a 217% increase over the 8-week baseline of 13.9 complaints/week—suggesting a sudden surge in congestion, illegal pickups, or traffic violations in Fort Greene/Brooklyn Heights this past week.
evidence: 44 for-hire vehicle complaints last week vs. 13.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.3)
217% spike represents one of the sharpest deviations in district 311 data
No prior Reddit or news coverage suggests this is emerging, not long-running
reporting_angles: Interview residents on specific streets (Fulton, Flatbush, Atlantic) about illegal pickups, double-parking, congestion
Query TLC on enforcement activity and pending permits; compare permit growth to complaint spike

themes_detail.label: NYPD Real-Time Enforcement Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Real-time enforcement complaints jumped to 8 this week versus a baseline of 0.5 complaints/week over 8 weeks—a 1,500% spike (z-score: 10.61)—potentially indicating a new policing operation, controversial stop-and-frisk activity, or traffic enforcement that residents are contesting.
evidence: 8 real-time enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (z-score: 10.61, severity: high)
1,500% increase represents explosive spike in a historically quiet complaint category
Timing suggests possible new NYPD initiative or operation launched within last 7 days
reporting_angles: Contact NYPD Patrol Borough Brooklyn North for statement on any new enforcement push or operation
Interview community members and legal advocates on nature of complaints (traffic, stop-and-frisk, other)
Cross-reference with 311 data on Investigations and Discipline complaints (also up 1,100% this week)

themes_detail.label: Residential Disposal / Trash Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Residential disposal complaints surged to 10 this week—a 300% jump from the 2.5 weekly average—suggesting a new waste collection failure, illegal dumping uptick, or bulky item crisis in the district this week.
evidence: 10 residential disposal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.5 weekly average (z-score: 8.66)
300% spike is statistically severe and recent
Aligns with broader heat/hot water complaints (1,596 over 90 days), suggesting possible building/infrastructure stress affecting sanitation services
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Sanitation (DSNY) on any service disruptions, route changes, or labor issues affecting CD 302 this week
Canvass Brooklyn Heights and Fort Greene streets for visible trash accumulation, illegal dumping evidence
Investigate whether construction permits (1,189 filings in 90 days) are blocking collection routes

themes_detail.label: Lead Dust & Construction Safety
themes_detail.summary: Construction lead dust complaints doubled from 0.5 to 4 last week—a 700% spike (z-score: 4.95)—during a period of heavy renovation activity (863 alteration permits filed in 90 days), raising concerns about lead remediation compliance and air quality.
evidence: 4 construction lead dust complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.95)
863 alteration permits filed in 90 days (high renovation activity in older Brooklyn Heights/Fort Greene housing stock)
Lead dust represents acute health hazard, especially for children under 6; correlates with aggressive renovation cycle
reporting_angles: DOB compliance audit: are contractors properly notifying residents and using containment for lead-based paint work?
Interview residents near active construction sites on visible dust, respiratory complaints, notification practices
Track DOB violations issued for lead-related violations in CD 302 over past 3 months

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Bike Glut
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned bike complaints surged from 0.2 to 4 per week last week—a 1,500% spike (z-score: 8.66)—indicating a possible bike-share system failure, theft ring, or illegal dumping of bikes clogging sidewalks.
evidence: 4 abandoned bike complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 8.66)
1,500% spike in a normally non-problematic category suggests sudden operational or criminal event
Fort Greene and Brooklyn Heights have dense Citi Bike coverage; spike may correlate with system maintenance or theft uptick
reporting_angles: Contact Citi Bike on any system-wide outages, maintenance windows, or theft reports in CD 302 last week
Visit hotspot locations (Promenade, Washington Park, Fulton) to document abandoned bikes and interview residents
Cross-check with police reports on bike theft rings or organized dumping activity
